judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the bug is unfixed and the newly added test will fail. Additionally, the candidate completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate left the new guarantee inside the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (which begins with 'This issue changes none of them') and failed to document what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened. Finally, the candidate committed an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file and created a separate test file instead of adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
